meta.name: ecosystem
meta.description: Audit the Claude Code ecosystem — skill health and staleness, project activity pulse, CLAUDE.md instruction drift, Mac Mini service status. Use this skill whenever the user asks about ecosystem health, stale skills, abandoned projects, system status, infrastructure check, "what's broken", "what's stale", "how's my setup", or any request to review the state of their Claude Code environment. Also triggers on "/ecosystem", "audit my ecosystem", "ecosystem health", "ecosystem audit".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Claude Code 生态的健康状态与技能过时情况
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常使用 Claude Code 并想确保环境整洁无误
copy.tagline_en: Check your Claude Code ecosystem for health and stale skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Claude Code and want to keep your setup healthy

howto.what: Claude 会扫描你的技能文件夹、项目仓库和 CLAUDE.md 文件，检查技能新鲜度、项目活动状态和指令漂移，还会 SSH 连接 Mac Mini 检查服务状态，最后生成一份审计报告并写入今日笔记。
howto.when: 当你询问生态健康、技能或项目状态、系统基础设施，或说出“什么坏了”、“我的设置怎么样”等话，或输入“/ecosystem”、“audit my ecosystem”等命令时触发。

say.text: 检查我的 Claude 生态健康。
say.note: 触发全面审计，报告技能、项目、Mac Mini 状态。

say.text: 帮我看看有哪些技能过时了。
say.note: 重点检查技能新鲜度和损坏的符号链接。

say.text: 运行生态审计，并写入今日笔记。
say.note: 执行完整审计并追加摘要到每日笔记。

howto.what_en: Claude scans your skills folder for freshness and broken symlinks, scans your projects for git activity and CLAUDE.md presence, checks CLAUDE.md drift against project commits, and SSH into Mac Mini to check services. Outputs a full report and appends a summary to today's daily note.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about ecosystem health, stale skills, project status, system or infrastructure check, or say 'what's broken', 'what's stale', 'how's my setup', or use commands like '/ecosystem', 'audit my ecosystem'.

say_en.note: Triggers full audit, reports skills, projects, Mac Mini.
Focuses on skill freshness and broken symlinks.

say_en.text: Run ecosystem audit and log to daily note.
say_en.note: Executes full audit and appends summary to daily note.
